title: R' Shimon HaMachozi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sukkah 45b (Hyman cites 45a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.45b.1): R' Yochanan reported in the name of R' Shimon HaMachozi, in the name of R' Yochanan HaMakhuti.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sukkah passage gives Rabbi Yochanan transmitting in Rabbi Shimon HaMachozi’s name, and Shimon transmitting in Rabbi Yochanan HaMakhuti’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3458&lang=en) cites 45b and gives the same chain.
